flags.message: Contact scrubbing gap: the provisioned petition.txt carries the pro se petitioner's personal email address in a form the scrubber missed (the OCR text splits it with internal spaces, so the pattern did not match, though documents.json reports contact_scrubbed: true with 5 replacements), and the provisioned snapshot's Petitioner block carries the same address verbatim in its Email field. Both files sit under record/ in the repository. Not quoted here; a maintainer can find it by searching the two files for the '@' character. Suggest hardening the scrubber against whitespace-broken addresses and scrubbing the snapshot's party Email field.

Forward-retrieval disclosure: read this case's own district-court dismissal opinion (E.D. Mich. 1:24-cv-11604, 2025-02-26) and the Sixth Circuit docket entries (No. 25-1514) via CourtListener. Both predate the petition and confirm the posture the petition describes; they nudged the forecast down modestly but were not decisive. The petition's own disposition was never sought and did not surface.
